label: Chechil
note: Made from skimmed, soured milk, scalded and pulled into strands, braided and kept in brine; Armenia and Georgia

about.text: A brined string cheese of Armenia and Georgia, usually made from skimmed cow milk that is soured, set with rennet, scalded and pulled into thin strands that are braided into coils.
